```{r}
library(doParallel)
library(parallel)
library(foreach)
```

```{r}
num_cores <- detectCores()
print(num_cores)
```
16 Cores


```{r}
start_time <- Sys.time()

for(i in 1:4000) {
  sample_data <- rnorm(100000, mean = 10, sd = 3)
  mean_val <- mean(sample_data)
}

end_time <- Sys.time()
time_taken <- end_time - start_time
print(time_taken)
```

```{r}
theoretical_time <- time_taken / num_cores
print(theoretical_time)
```

```{r}
Cores <- parallel::makeCluster(num_cores - 1)
doParallel::registerDoParallel(Cores)

start_time_parallel <- Sys.time()

foreach(i = 1:4000, .combine = c) %dopar% {
  sample_data <- rnorm(100000, mean = 10, sd = 3)
  mean_val <- mean(sample_data)
}

end_time_parallel <- Sys.time()
time_taken_parallel <- end_time_parallel - start_time_parallel
print(time_taken_parallel)

parallel::stopCluster(Cores)
```
